name: agentic-dev-workflows
description: Cross-cutting workflows for developing software with AI agents, on any platform or stack: take in voice notes, screenshots (incl. Google Photos albums) and screen recordings to steer the work, review the running UI for a focus such as simplification, resolve a UI friction point by options-then-build, and find complementary plugins. Backlog, sprints and release timing moved to the flow-control plugin.
